newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks end higher in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks end higher in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks ended higher in London on Wednesday with interest still focusing on companies with strong earnings.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares traded in London was up 16.16 points or 1.12 percent at 1,453.95, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo gained 233.78 points, or 1.12 percent, to 21,189.96.
Dealers said the market in London was marked by some profit-taking in issues such as Canon 6758q and Sony 7751q while there was some buying interests in several high-tech stocks.
They said they expected to see some follow-through buying on Thursday, but added they did not expect the move to push the index much higher.

"The mood is still the same as in Tokyo. People are buying companies backed by strong earnings and ignoring those with poor earnings," said one dealer at a Japanese brokerage. -- London Newsroom ++ 44 171 542 5106
